title: Deterministic cooperative async event loop scheduler

workspace.test_loop.py:
from loop import EventLoop

def test_loop():
    results = []
    def task(val):
        results.append(val)
        yield
        results.append(val + 10)
    el = EventLoop()
    el.spawn(task(1))
    el.run()
    assert results == [1, 11]
